page.overview:
Who is Casanova?

Casanova was allegedly a Tilean man known for his romantic exploits was became famous across the Old World for his charm and adventurous love life.

In the Warhammer setting, "Casanova" often appears as a nickname or reference rather than a distinct historical figure. The name is typically used to describe characters known for their romantic exploits, much like the real-world [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Giacomo_Casanova Giacomo Casanova] of the Republic of Venice in the eighteenth century.

One such character is Adalbert Henschmann, a known flirt and charmer who is the president of the League of Gentlemen Entrepreneurs, the thieves' guild of Marienburg, whose nickname "Casanova" suggests he shares qualities with the historical Casanova of Venice. Henschmann's reputation as a "great lover" mirrors the real Casanova's, and his nickname serves to add flavour to the world of Mallus by hinting that similar romantic archetypes exist within its lore.

There is another character who references Casanova, Kahsonnava of Praag, also considered a legendary lover.
